entities.name: Nestor Nyzhankivskyi

entities.summary: Nestor Nyzhankivsky ; August 31, 1893 – April 10, 1940) was a Ukrainian composer, pianist and music critic. Received his doctoral degree in history from the University of Vienna and graduated from the Prague State Conservatory.
